evidence_class: mocked Redis and server clock; fixture network; signed fixture grants
fixture: Delayed command delivery, a duplicated poll response and a drain whose acknowledgement is dropped by the network, built on the SV2-LDG-02 heartbeat world; the worker state file lives in a pytest tmp_path folder
fixture_clock: The fixture server clock starts at 1000 ms; command expiry 50 ms, delivery delay 30 ms, late delivery 60 ms, poll interval 10 ms
cleanup: Each run uses its own fakeredis instance and tmp_path folder; nothing outside them is written
mutation_scope: Worker command records in the fixture swarm only; no ledger document is opened, so the ledger stays the single writer of operator work state
